- scripts/claude_session_janitor.py, _REPO pattern (line 57) and its use in _terminal_pr_age_hours (line 259) and _issue_closed (line 270)
  HARDENING_SUGGESTION: The _REPO regex `[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+` accepts `.` and `..` as complete path segments from session titles (operator-controlled data). A title like `PR ../users#12 — fixed review` would produce the gh api path `repos/../users/pulls/12`, which after HTTP path normalization redirects the GET to a different API endpoint. The conformance review (run 1) explicitly accepted this as a low-risk HYPOTHESIS: only the operator's own sessions set titles, the call is a read-only GET, the worst case is a 404 (session kept), and archiving is reversible. Tightening the pattern would add defense in depth by rejecting path traversal segments before they reach the API path.
  SUGGESTED_MINIMAL_FIX: Add a validation check after extracting the repo from the title, before constructing the API path: reject segments that are exactly `.` or `..` by checking `all(segment not in ('.', '..') for segment in repo.split('/'))` and raising ValueError if it fails. This keeps the regex unchanged for valid repo names containing dots while blocking path traversal.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
